artikel.titel: FX Daily: Tech collapses, FX shrugs
artikel.text: A delayed reaction to the Democrat blue wave has seen some powerful selling of tech stocks. A little surprisingly, the reaction in FX markets has remained very muted. FX participants so far see this as an idiosyncratic re-pricing of the tech sector, rather than a harbinger of recession. Expect defensive FX to outperform, rather than a broad dollar decline

artikel.titel: Asia week ahead: Philippine GDP and key data on China, Taiwan, and Japan
artikel.text: ASIA/PACIFIC: Philippine GDP is the highlight of the week, alongside China’s inflation and trade data, Taiwan’s trade figures, and Japan’s household spending and price indicators

artikel.titel: German industry defies higher energy prices and low water levels – for now
artikel.text: EUROPE: Activity in the automotive and construction sectors experienced a post-holiday surge in September, adding to the resilience of German industry

artikel.titel: Rates Spark: Treasury heat from tech flight - but for how long?
artikel.text: A creeping move lower in equities would eventually be ignored by Treasuries. But a large dump in equities would not. Treasuries are so far very much in vogue. In Europe, bond spreads are widening again as we head into another weekend of street unrest. Friday sees US jobs data competing for the spotlight, although Thursday's low claims were broadly ignored

artikel.titel: Czech National Bank review: The new neutral normal
artikel.text: CENTRAL AND EASTERN EUROPE: The CNB increased the policy rate to 4%, in line with market expectations. However, the decision was very close, a 4-3 split. The new CNB forecast is revised toward a punchier inflation amid a softer economic expansion, implying a higher rates trajectory. We see 4% as the new normal, while further hikes will be restrained by dwindling economic activity

artikel.titel: Energy shock keeps a 1Q27 rate hike on the table in Poland
artikel.text: CENTRAL AND EASTERN EUROPE: Poland's central bank is increasingly alert to inflation risks from the prolonged energy shock, despite limited evidence of second-round effects so far. Governor Adam Glapiński signalled that the Monetary Policy Council is ready to act if needed. We maintain our call for 50bp of rate hikes in 1Q27

artikel.titel: How the blue wave could reshape US energy and data centres
artikel.text: NORTH AMERICA: Energy affordability shaped the midterms. A divided government will now face pressure to shield consumers from rising data centre power costs while speeding up new energy supply. Onshoring and trade protections will continue, despite higher near-term costs, as energy security remains a priority

artikel.titel: Hawkish Bank of England hikes rates, and there’s more to come
artikel.text: UNITED KINGDOM: The Bank of England has raised interest rates to 4%, and we expect one further rate hike by February. A renewed spike in energy prices could bring that forward to December. However, we're still sceptical that the Bank will need to hike more than once more

artikel.titel: France’s manufacturing rebound offers some relief, but no turning point yet
artikel.text: EUROPE: French manufacturing output rose for a second consecutive month in September, led by a sharp rebound in car production. But with output still below last year’s level and construction firmly in recession, industry can only soften, not reverse, the economy’s stagnation

artikel.titel: AI in 2027: 20 questions for the global economy
artikel.text: AI: The AI boom is reshaping growth, productivity, trade, jobs and markets. Investment still has room to run in 2027, but financing is getting riskier and expectations are sky-high. We ask how long it can last, who stands to gain and what happens if the promised returns fail to arrive

trendfolge.regel: Absolute Momentum, 3 Monate (63 Handelstage), täglich entschieden (Antonacci 2014: 12 Monate, monatlich)
trendfolge.hinweis: Täglich entschieden und 3 statt 12 Monate Rückschau sind eigene Wahl, das Paper entscheidet monatlich über 12 Monate. Beides bringt mehr Fehlsignale, wenn der Markt schnell dreht. Keine Anlageberatung.
